Christina Rossetti, Folake Mansour, and colleagues tracked quarterly loan approvals in a regional small-business credit program. They found that some loan categories received no approvals at all during particular quarters of the year; for example, the program did not approve even one _____
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?

choices.A: microloan in the fourth quarter of 2023.
choices.B: export-trade loan in the first quarter of 2023.
choices.C: microloan in the first quarter of 2023.
choices.D: equipment loan in the second and third quarters of 2023.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. According to the graph, the number of equipment loan approvals was zero in both the second and third quarters of 2023. This data effectively completes the example by providing a specific case in which a loan category received no approvals at all, consistent with the claim that the program 'did not approve even one' loan.
